purpose: Second summary-preservation experiment; candidate rejected for production promotion
environment: Mac only, original Qwen3.5 9B, 4096 context, 1000 output tokens, temperature 0; no Acer changes
design: Four new scenarios and preservation prompt fixed before these runs. Production baseline on new four only; candidate on previous eight plus new four. No Huihui rerun in this experiment. One sample per condition.
limits: Unblinded assistant review, not independent human acceptance
Small synthetic sample; no statistical/general quality claim
Quoted payload reproduction is a summary no-echo failure, not evidence of tool execution
Residency snapshots are not peak memory measurements
